content.short: Spinor is a real-time blockchain with distributed computing for AI agents, simulations, and high-performance dApps.
content.description: Spinor redefines how computation scales in distributed systems by prioritizing locality over traditional linear computation and global state. This approach enables hyper-localized processing that preserves performance and real-time responsiveness across globally dispersed networks. By addressing the locality challenge in distributed computing, Spinor delivers supercomputing-level performance and instant responsiveness, providing the efficiency required for the next generation of infrastructure and globally coordinated applications.
